items.name: veil_r8
items.prompt:
Close-up bust portrait, chest-up, head in the upper third, slight three-quarter turn, head lowered a little, looking up toward the camera from under his hood. A hard overhead key light from the upper left is blocked by the hood's projecting edge, so a soft natural shadow covers his forehead and eyes, the eyes dim and deep-set in the shade with a faint catchlight, never a black band; everything below the cheekbones is lit. Original character art for NEXUS, a near-future professional tactical sport league. The subject is Veil, a professional athlete: a lean, wiry man in his mid thirties with narrow shoulders and a long neck. Gaunt angular lower face, a long narrow jaw, thin lips pressed shut, faint dark stubble, olive matte skin. On his right cheekbone, just below the shadow line, a faint old burn mark: a small area of smooth, slightly paler skin, subtle and fully healed. A slim black competition comms microphone runs along his left jawline. He wears a deep structured hood of heavy stiff grey technical canvas; an internal rod holds its opening as a rigid arch that projects forward beyond his brow. A thin indigo-violet piping follows the inner seam of the hood opening. His overcoat is made of heavy matte charcoal composite panels, a tall stand-up collar and no lapels, open at the front, hanging in straight vertical pleats; underneath, a fitted high-necked graphite-grey athletic compression suit. On the left side of the image, behind his right shoulder, rise the tops of a row of exactly four slim matte gunmetal canisters, four in a row, standing vertically side by side, each with a thin glowing indigo-violet ring at its joint. Indigo-violet appears only on those rings and the hood piping, nowhere else. The gear is certified competition equipment, lightweight and used: scuffed edges, a stretched shoulder strap, one replacement panel in a slightly different grey. Silent, methodical, still.
Premium competitive video game key art, stylized realism with a subtle painted finish, sharp focus, rich material detail, clean readable silhouette. Hard cool white key light high from the upper left, very dim fill from the right, a thin cool rim light along his contour. Isolated on a plain flat seamless neutral mid-grey studio backdrop with no coloured light on it. No text, no logos, no weapons, no smoke, no mask.
